prompt: Match each data structure to how you write an empty one.
explain: {} is an empty dictionary, not an empty set — a set with nothing in it has to be written set().

prompt: Match each expression to its result when nums = [10, 20, 30, 40, 50].
explain: A slice stops before its end index, so nums[1:3] is positions 1 and 2. Negative indexes count back from the end.

prompt: Which of these can be changed after they are created?
explain: Lists and dictionaries are mutable. Tuples and strings are not — operations on them build a new value instead.
